summary: Sends a chat reply back for a rewrite when it plans a headless Claude CLI call instead of the CLI you chose.
doc: This Stop hook reads the reply the model is about to finish with and blocks it when a sentence plans a headless Claude CLI call, such as running claude -p over each file or a headless Claude judge. The model then rewrites the reply with the CLI named in the GUARDHOOKS_HEADLESS_CLI environment variable. It pairs with no-claude-p, which covers files and shell commands. A sentence about the rule passes when it also says not, never, instead, replaced, legacy or reports an error, and a sentence that names the chosen CLI passes. To quote the command on purpose, put it in a fenced code block, an inline backtick span, a '>' blockquote or a double-quoted span. The hook blocks at most once per turn.
